authority.color_policy: Score/Auto/HUD colors come from serialized Float32/Color32 and IL2CPP string constants; device frames validate composition but are never sampled to invent production colors.
authority.runtime_policy: R1 observation only; no return replacement, managed invocation, target memory write, pointer export or account/display-string export.
authority.old_closure_policy: Prior profiles are consumed as static inventory only. Their old aggregate production_authorization flags are ignored and do not flow into this closure.

encoded_text.overflow: not truncated; maxDigit only controls prepended zero count
encoded_text.shrink_content_rule: decrement integer font size only while shaped run width exceeds serialized widget width 188; eight digits remain 28, nine-digit 009000000 begins at 27

rank_position.prohibition: Serialized rank-root x values are prefab placeholders; C/B/A/S/SS must each be overwritten by CalculateScoreReachObjectPositionX during SetupRankObject.

ss_effect.trigger: Score.onChangedScoreGaugeRank only when the rank changes to SS (5), SSS (6), or original mode 12 branch; ordinary score updates inside the same rank do not restart the Animator.
ss_effect.prohibition: Do not restart ScoreGaugeSS on every Score.UpdateView/reflect. The 3-second looping clip advances continuously after one rank-transition trigger.

scene.runtime_parent: InGamePlayDisplay.autoLiveLabelRoot resolves scene content root path 506; instantiated caption local transform is owned by that root.

add_score.ownership: Four pooled AddScoreObject roots under UI_Root_Back/Display/Information/AddScore/Offset; each root owns seven UISpriteNumber slots and preserves the serialized hierarchy/depth/transform.

layout_formula.pause: Right+Top StarUIAnchor to normalized safe area; serialized child (-42,-54), 68x70 and circle radius 0.15 use existing FitWidth*ScreenToSafeArea control scale.
layout_formula.modal: Dialog roots are centered; serialized transforms and widgets use the same existing control scale. No screenshot coordinate is consumed.

pause.button_disposition: DisableButton occurs during setup, EnableButton occurs before Playing, and no DisableButton is called when the Pause dialog opens; the serialized Pause Sprite remains visible over the modal frame.
pause.requirement: Instantiate the complete serialized dialog graph and mutate its components. A hand-built window/text/button graph and hiding the Pause Sprite when the menu opens are both rejected.

flash.owner: one slide-head slideNoteFlashAnimator/Sprite only; NoteSlideAfter owns no flash component
flash.placement: The flash is a child of the Slide root. The root remains at the judgement line after head judgement while current NoteSlideAfter nodes advance; the flash is not attached to each authored intermediate node.

mesh.visibility: Segments are projected from launcher through target; a product graph must not clip every segment to the lower half or derive expected vertices from its own production helper.

lane_effect.runtime_requirement: Each judgement performs On then OffReserve; AnimatedOff begins on the following outer update. Retriggering the same slot restarts the owner. Pause/MoveTime/Retry/game-clear perform explicit all-off cleanup.

judgement_particles.requirement: Use default effect master id 1/skin00 unless the selected original Skin setting says otherwise; apply each ParticleSystem authored parent chain, simulationSpace/scalingMode, GamePlayButton transform and sorting stage. Flick is not a normal-particle alias.

game_clear.lifecycle: Natural BGM end enters GameClearAnimStart (11), plays the base clear graph plus the clear-status additional graph, waits for RhythmGameClearAnimController.ClearAnimationFinished, enters GameClearAnimEnd (12), and only then begins onExit.

runtime_observation.pause_button_disposition: DisableButton occurs during setup, EnableButton occurs before Playing, and no DisableButton is called when the Pause dialog opens; the serialized Pause Sprite remains visible over the modal frame.
